write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for pharmacy technician work: it connects inpatient sterile compounding, cabinet restocking, and retail pharmacy experience to the volume you handled. A recruiter can see both your California license and what you do in the inpatient pharmacy.

The cabinet restocking line is a great model! It names the six nursing units and shows the change in weekly stockout reports. Your duties sit in a separate table from the jobs, though, so a recruiter has to look back and forth to match the work to each employer.
Let's put the duties under their respective roles and give the earlier clerk work a little more detail. Your resume is already strong; how competitive a particular job is will matter too.
